newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.0 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 12.0 percent to domestic and foreign institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper on May 21, the central bank sold 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes at the same rate.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is May 30 and maturity will be on May 30, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 29.8 billion
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 16.3 billion
Phuong Nam Commercial Joint Stock Bank 1.6 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 0.7 billion
